name: Sri Sairam Engineering College
summary: Sri Sairam Engineering College was established in 1995 by MJF Ln. Leo Muthu of the Sapthagiri Educational Trust as a non-profit, non-minority college in West Tambaram. It is autonomous and affiliated to Anna University, with NAAC 'A+' and NBA accreditation for all its UG programmes.
